title: Download, eSIM setup, and lid unlock failures
summary: The sampled feedback centers on failed downloads or setup completion and one clear complaint about an intermittently failing lid door unlock/open function.

negative.summary: The negative review describes a lid door that intermittently fails to unlock and open during operation.

undetermined.summary: The undetermined reviews mention a download failure and an eSIM setup or connection that never fully completes, but they do not provide enough context to confirm overall sentiment.

limitations: The topic appears to mix at least two subjects: a physical lid door unlock/open issue and digital download or eSIM setup problems.
Two of the three sampled fragments are too brief to determine overall review sentiment with confidence.
The sample is very small and stratified, so it should not be treated as representative of all reviews about this topic.
